skills.name: branch-cycle-audit
skills.description: Verify branch ownership for session/cycle/intermediate branches and enforce cycle mapping invariants.

skills.name: close-session
skills.description: Finalize session, enforce drift check, update snapshot, validate branch context consistency.

skills.name: context-reload
skills.description: Reload project context, detect active branch/cycle alignment, propose work mode (THINKING/EXPLORING/COMMITTING), and generate a concise Context Reload Report.

skills.name: convert-to-spike
skills.description: Convert an ongoing EXPLORING effort into an official SPIKE cycle + dedicated branch recommendation.

skills.name: crash-recovery
skills.description: Recover safely after an abrupt stop, restart, or suspected partial runtime write in an aidn repository using shared coordination. Use when local backlog or handoff artifacts may be missing or stale, when PostgreSQL shared state may be ahead of local files, or when the next safe action is to reanchor, rematerialize planning, regenerate a handoff packet, or restore shared coordination.

skills.name: cycle-close
skills.description: Close a cycle safely (VERIFYING → DONE or non-retained outcome), run exit checklist (REQ/TEST/GAP/CR), update status.md, snapshot, and next entry point.

skills.name: cycle-create
skills.description: Create a new cycle folder (CXXX-[type]) with required artifacts, initialize status.md with branch_name and guardrails fields.

skills.name: drift-check
skills.description: Detect scope drift (A/B/D), generate a Recovery plan, and optionally create a CR + parking-lot entries.

skills.name: handoff-close
skills.description: Prepare an explicit relay for another agent by refreshing current state, runtime digest, and handoff packet with a concrete next-agent goal.

skills.name: pr-orchestrate
skills.description: Orchestrate the session PR lifecycle after close-session: push, open PR, track review, and enforce post-merge sync.

skills.name: promote-baseline
skills.description: Promote a DONE cycle to baseline if conditions are met, update baseline current/history + snapshot + index.

skills.name: requirements-delta
skills.description: Revise an old plan/spec safely by generating an addendum (delta), mapping old→new REQs, and opening CR or new cycle if structural changes are detected.

skills.name: start-session
skills.description: Create or resume a session file from template, detect branch context, and prepare cycle-aware working context.
